failures.prompt_note: After offer resolution, report each explicit payment clause sequentially before speaking the final next_step; otherwise the second promised product may be omitted when all hardship products have been settled.

failures.reason: Latest why-question exception takes precedence over refusal in the same utterance. No record_decline for “I am not comfortable ... Why do you need it?” or “I will not provide ... Why is this necessary?”. One run never closes and repeats goodbye to turn cap.
failures.root: builder/compile.py:428 and :445 unconditionally exempt messages containing a security-purpose question, even when refusal is also explicit.
failures.patch: In both id_common and record_decline tool description replace exception with: "ONLY a question with no refusal, unwillingness or request to skip is not a decline. If the same message also says they will not answer, are not comfortable giving the required information, or want to proceed without it, call record_decline FIRST. An accompanying why-question does not cancel that refusal. After the tool follow the counter state; never announce an end or say goodbye yourself."
examples: Why do you need my date of birth? -> clarification only
I will not provide the digits. Why is this necessary? -> record_decline
I am not comfortable giving that over the phone. Why do you need it? -> record_decline
